about_short_description.short_description: ARKIN Technologies develops, operates and markets financial technology platforms for consumers, businesses and government agencies.

product.name: eWallet Platform / Mobile eWallet
product.description: A virtual bank account for various transactions like deposits, withdrawals, money transfers, bill payments, shopping, and card activations, accessible anytime with a transaction log.

product.name: Payment Gateway
product.description: A secure online system facilitating real-time payments for e-commerce activities.

product.name: Issuing Platform
product.description: Supports issuing of debit, credit, prepaid, and contactless cards, wearables, or devices for financial institutions.

product.name: Card Management Platform
product.description: A system for issuing and acquiring, managing various card types and contactless technologies, tracking BIN formats for security.

product.name: Switch Technology
product.description: Connects financial systems for unified transaction processing.

product.name: 2 Factor Authentication
product.description: An additional security layer ensuring account access is exclusive to the user.
